title: Days Left in the Transition Window and the Transition Fill
content:
**Pharmacy Benefit — calendar rule for newly enrolled members.** The transition fill days of a non-formulary drug turned away at the counter start from the window days.

**Rule.** The window days count the calendar days left in the transition window, which is the plan's transition window days less the days from the coverage effective date to today: where fewer than fourteen (14) days are left the window days are fourteen, where fourteen or more days are left but fewer than the plan's transition fill days supply the window days are the days left, and otherwise the window days are the plan's transition fill days supply.

The coverage effective date is the effective date of the member's pharmacy coverage; the days to today are calendar days.

### Method table

| Calendar days left in the transition window | Window days |
|---|---|
| Fewer than 14 | A fixed 14 |
| 14 or more, but fewer than the plan's transition fill days supply | The days left |
| At least the plan's transition fill days supply | The plan's transition fill days supply |

### Boundary cases (hypothetical plan: transition window 90 days, transition fill days supply 30)

| Days from the coverage effective date to today | Days left | Window days |
|---|---|---|
| 40 | 50 | 30 |
| 60 | 30 | 30 |
| 61 | 29 | 29 |
| 76 | 14 | 14 |
| 77 | 13 | 14 |
